row.notes: Reads a quantised float from a bit stream (stream+0x10 data, +0x1c size, +0x24 bit pos, +0x28 error, +0x29 raw-mode): bit count = ceil(log2((max-min)/step)), value = bits*step+min clamped to [min,max]; raw mode path reads a full float via 143926090; escape code 0xF via Ne_BitStream_ReadRangedUInt. Addon: network/replay vehicle-state decode. Callers Car_TyreSets_ReadSetEntry, Game_Network_DeserialiseVehicle.
